project_full_markdown: # 国家自然科学基金 资助项目结题报告 资助类别：青年科学基金项目 亚类说明： 附注说明： 项目名称：皇家文化影响下的文化景观遗产保护理论与实践研究 负责人：邬东璠电话：010-62794711 电子邮件：wudongfan@tsinghua.edu.cn 依托单位：清华大学 联系人：宿芬电话：62784622 资助金额：20（万元）累计拨款：20.0(万元） 执行年限：2011.01-2013.12 填表日期：2013年12月23日 制（2012年） ## 项目摘要 ## 中文摘要(500字以内)： 长期以来，中国对自身文化景观的遗产价值缺乏认识，伴随近年来国际学者对中国文化景观的关注，国内业界才开始觉醒，认识到在中国成熟的风景名胜区及文物保护单位体系中，隐藏着巨大的文化景观遗产潜力。然而与世界遗产体系接轨的相关研究十分匮乏，有中国特色的相关保护理论和方法尚属空白。本研究拟从"研究对象界定、保护要素研究、保护方法研究、实践应用研究"等4个方面展开，以皇家文化影响下的文化景观为研究对象，对接世界遗产相关理论，通过整合现行的风景名胜区与文物保护单位两套体系下的保护理论和方法，并借鉴非物质文化遗产的保护理念，对文化景观遗产中所蕴含的自然、物质文化与非物质文化三类要素进行整合保护研究。以西方的逻辑思维方式解析景观文化要素和载体，再以东方的诗性智慧，将分解筛选后的文化要素与保护方法加以综合，形成新的适合皇家文化景观遗产特质的保护理论框架，并为更大范围的中国文化景观遗产保护提供可资参照的理论框架。 关键词(不超过5个，用分号分开)：文化景观；世界遗产；景观文化；保护与实践； ## Abstract (limited to 1500 characters): For a long time, the recognization of the value of the national Cultural L andscape Heritages(CLH) is lack in China. In recent years, along with the wid ely international attention, Chinese scholars have been waking up and beginin g to focus on the great potential of CLH in the National Parks and Historical & Cultural Sites under Government Protection. While short of relevant resear ches which can correspond to the international heritage system, there are big gaps on CLH' s conservation theories and methods in China. This research will study on 4 aspects: the definition of research object, the conservation elem ents, the conservation methods, practice and application. Focusing on the CLH s under the royal culture influence and jointing with the World Heritae theo ries, this research will study on the integration protection of the 3 element s of CLH: natural element, meterial cultural element and intangible cultural element. It will integrate the conservation theories and methods of the two d ifferent govermental protection system which are National Parks protection sy stem and Historical & Cultural Sites protection system, and also learn from t he protection concepts of intangible cultural heritage. Using western logical thinking mode to analysize the elements & carriers of the CLH, and eastern p oetic thinking mode to composite the chosen cultrual elements & protection me thods, the researchers will make a new CLH protection theory frame appropriat e to the royal chractors and also provide a reference for the wider range of CLH protection in China. Keywords (limited to 5 keywords,seperated by;):Cultural Landscape; World Heritage; Landscape Culture; Conservation and Practice; ## 结题摘要 ## 中文摘要(对项目的完成情况及取得成果做简单概述，1000字以内)： 本课题旨在从文化景观的核心动因——景观文化的视角认识和保护文化景观遗产，借鉴系统科学的相关方法认识和控制文化景观及其景观文化系统。遵循“整体论与还原论辩证统一”的系统方法论，对景观文化系统的要素做出符合研究尺度的还原性研究与整体性研究。 从系统的角度对景观文化进行深入认知：1）景观文化系统具有深层结构和表层结构；2）文化景观作为一个系统存在成型、保型、转型的可能；3）文化景观系统对不同对象有不同功能；4）景观文化要素核心要素、衍生要素及附加要素，其中核心要素是关键组分，附加及衍生要素是可变组分。5）皇家文化的影响相当于不同程度的系统“他组织”过程。统治者的介入意味着对主流意识形态的强力引导。 对我国文化景观遗产保护现状反思：1）在我国建设口与文物口两套体系中，对于非物质形态的文化行为无论从认知、保护、监测到控制各个层面都存在缺环；2）文化景观不能被有效的整体性管理，多头管理、多规并存的问题很C 因此引入公众参与、树立共同的保护管理目标，同时加强规划的法律效力、规划师全程参与规划实施过程、多规合一，是保证规划有效指导实践的关键。 借鉴国外文化景观保护经验：1）欧洲对传统意义上“非精英”文化景观的历史价值逐渐提高了认可度，认为不要全面清除过去，片段保留的方式适合大多数“非显著价值”文化景观的保护。2）借鉴美国文化景观清查的经验，对文化景观制定保护管理规划可以采用层次性、优先性及多级机构参与的方式。3）意大利的整体保护理念、有效的法律法规和到位的执法、包容地方特殊性及激发民众自觉性的借鉴；日本非物质文化“心意传承”的借鉴；以及韩国通过文化景观引导社会风尚的借鉴。 文化景观是具有生命的遗产，因此应持发展的眼光看待保护。1）“活着”的文化景观作为“自组织”系统极易被外力影响，可以借鉴系统控制学中的补偿控制及反馈控制。2）文化景观遗产作为开放系统，需要与外界环境进行物质、能量、信息的交换，因此要关注遗产边界外的关联性要素，加强对这些“非精英”文化景观的保护利用与展示。3）对文化景观遗产在当代的价值进行挖掘。4）小心对待需要“心意传承”的非物质文化要素，减少旅游或外界观念的强力干扰。旅游开发对于可以“模型传承”的非物质文化要素有正面作用。 综上研究，初步创建一套文化景观的景观文化系统认知与保护体系的框架：演绎与归纳-耦合-评估与策略-监测与反馈。 关键词(不超过5个，用分号分开)：文化景观遗产；景观文化系统；遗产保护；天坛;五台山 ## Abstract (limited to 3000 characters): Landscape culture(LC) is the core motivation of the cultural landscape heritage (CLH). This paper aims to recognize and protect CLH from the view of LC and the systems sience. For an in-depth understanding of LC from the view of system: 1) LC system has deep structure and surface structure; 2) As a system, cultural landscape(CL)has the possible of shaping, mataining and transformation;3)CL system has different functions on different objects; 4) The elements of LC include core elements, derived elements and attached elements. 5)The royal culture's effection is equivalent to other-organizing process of system. The governer's intervention means the strong guidance of the mainstream ideology. Reflection on the Chiese CLH protection status: 1) There are two Sets of protection institution in our country, construction administry and cultural relics protention administry, which having less attention on the intangible cultural behavior’s cognition, protection, monitor and control;2) CL cannot be managed effectively by the whole beyond the bull management and the coexistence of multi plannings. Therefore the introduction of public participation to establish common goals, while strengthening the legal effect, the planners participation in the whole planning and implementation process, and merging multi plannings, are the key to ensure the planning's effective guidance. Learning from the CL protection experience of foreign countries: 1) The European pay more attention on the traditional "non elite"CL’s historical value gradually. Other than deleting all the past relics, they reserved fragment of the “non significant value” CL. 2) Reference the American CL’s inventory experience, use the methods of levelly, priority and multi institutions participation while making planning. 3) Reference the Italian overall protection concept, effective laws and regulations' enforcement,containing of special local requirement and inspiring people's self-conscious; Japanese intangible cultural heritage's "mind inheritance";South Korean guiding the social conscious by the CL. The CL is alive heritage, and therefore should be protected through the view of development. 1) Alive CL as "self-organizing" system is vulnerable to external influence. We can learn from the compensation control and feedback control in system control theory. 2) As an open system, the CLH need exchange material, energy and information with environment. So attention should be paid to the relevant factors outside the boundary of the heritage, strengthen the protection, utilization and interpretation of the "non elite"CL. 3)Mining the CLH' s contemporary value. 4) Beware of intangible cultural external ideas.elements of "mind inheritance",reduce the strong interference of tourism or We established a preliminary framework on the LC’s cognition and protection, which including of 4 steps: deductive and inductive, coupling,Evaluation and strategy, monitoring and feedback. Keywords (limited to 5 keywords,seperated by;): Cultural landscape heritage;system of landscape culture; heritage protection; the Temple of Heaven; Mount Wutai
